title: Harry Reid's special access program request denied by William Lynn
summary: Eric Davis tells of Harry Reid's special access program request denied by William Lynn, about 2009 at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: mean, Harry Reid tried to get a special access program and he failed because Deputy Secretary of Defense William Lynn denied it.

plain: Eric Davis, a scientist who has worked on Pentagon research, says that around 2009 US Senator Harry Reid tried to set up a special access program, which is a tightly restricted secret government project, apparently for UFO research. According to Davis, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, the request failed because William Lynn, then the Deputy Secretary of Defense, the second highest civilian at the Pentagon, turned it down. If true, it would mean even a powerful senator was blocked from deeper secret access to the subject.
